request.style: English, male voice, soulful and contemplative, solo with gospel choir support, upright bass, electric guitar, piano, drums, warm and reverent mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
LORD our Lord how majestic is your name
You have set your splendor above the heavens high
From the mouths of children and infants
You established strength to silence the enemy

[Chorus]
What is a human being that you remember him
A son of man that you care for him
What is a human being that you remember him
A son of man that you care for him

[Verse]
When I look at your heavens the work of your fingers
The moon and the stars that you set in place
What is a human being that you remember him
A son of man that you care for him

[Chorus]
What is a human being that you remember him
A son of man that you care for him
What is a human being that you remember him
A son of man that you care for him

[Bridge]
You made him a little lower than God
And crowned him with glory and honor
You gave him dominion over the works of your hands
You put everything under his feet

[Outro]
All the flocks and herds and the beasts of the field
You remember him you care for him
